category: Institution management ERP for temples, trusts and Dharmic organisations
description: Sanatani Bandhan is an offline-first ERP and community super app for Sanatana Dharma institutions. It runs an institution's treasury, devotees, sevas, festivals, assets and community in one workspace, bridged by a Universal Sanatani ID. Every account action is recorded in a hash-chained, tamper-evident audit history, and trustees can publish monthly accounts on a public Transparency Board. It works fully offline and on low-cost phones, in 10 languages.
deviceFloor: Android 8 or later, 2GB RAM, 360px-wide screens; runs in any modern browser and installs as a PWA
features: Offline-first: registers, treasury entries and bookings work with zero internet and sync when the network returns
Universal Sanatani ID — one identity connects a devotee to every institution they serve
Role-based access control (SuperAdmin, Trustee, Accountant, Priest, Purohit, Jyotishi, Sevadar, Devotee)
Hash-chained, tamper-evident audit history — 100% who-did-what, with a receipt for every donation
Public Transparency Board — trustees publish monthly accounts (totals and categories only, never donor names) for any devotee to see
Treasury with instant exact totals from workspace summaries, 80G donation receipts
Floor-proof: full function on 2GB RAM, Android 8+ and 360px-wide screens; premium experience on flagship phones and desktop
Sacred terms are never translated; Indian number formatting (lakh/crore) throughout
